version_guard: Verify the published version 1.0.6 before reading results.

scoring.metric: Headline score on a private 657-task held-out split of AutomationBench dataset version 1.0.6: a task receives 0 if the model violates any guardrail, and errored tasks also score 0; otherwise the task receives the percentage of objectives the model completed, which the maintainer serves as a decimal fraction on a 0-1 scale
scoring.notes: Values retain this source implementation and score convention; different harnesses, subsets, judge revisions and versions must remain separate., which carries the headline score on a 0-1 scale (the methodology states it as a percentage); values keep the field's own 0-1 scale.

description: Tests multi-app SaaS workflows through REST tools on a held-out AutomationBench split.
